sub_sector.value: consumer cross-border remittances to Latin America

financial_business_type.detail: Money transfer company sending remittances via agents, app and web; also bill pay, phone top-ups, money orders.

revenue_driver.detail: Transfer fees and foreign exchange margin on remittances, plus bill payment and related services.

customer_type.detail: Individual migrants sending money to family abroad, through retail agents, app and online.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Transaction-based money transfer with little lending or underwriting risk.

notes: Revenue mix (fees versus foreign exchange spread) is not detailed in the evidence.
